method: Walked the rendered /photography/albums browse page on a dev server against production data. Album cards for mixed photo+video albums now read '363 photos · 134 videos' where they read '363 photos' — verified in the served aria-label for all four affected albums (Raiders Open, Jalapeno Open, Bell Pepper June, KRUSH), and compared against the live pre-fix build which still shows '363 photos'. Video-only albums are unchanged ('94 videos', '14 videos') and photo-only albums are unchanged ('100 photos'). No copy strings were edited; AlbumCard's existing sentence assembly simply receives a real number instead of a hardcoded 0.
